hero.title: MBA for an AI World (With Dual Specialisation)
hero.lead: ATLAS ISME’s MBA is not just a degree, it’s your AI-powered launchpad into leadership. A future-ready MBA that combines strong management foundations with the power of AI and analytics.

panes.label: Overview

text.strong: MBA in FinTech at ATLAS ISME

text: is designed for future fintech leaders, product innovators, financial analysts and digital finance specialists. Whether you aim to build fintech products, manage digital financial ecosystems, or lead innovation in financial services, this programme equips you to thrive in a rapidly evolving industry.

text.strong: You will learn to combine financial expertise with emerging technologies, data with decision-making and strategy with innovation.

text: From digital banking and blockchain to financial modelling, risk management and algorithmic trading, every subject is delivered with strong real-world application in modern finance.

cards.title: Build expertise in digital banking, fintech products and financial technologies
Apply data-driven insights through big data, analytics and algorithmic trading
Develop strong capabilities in financial modelling, valuation and risk management
Integrate blockchain, cybersecurity and emerging technologies in finance
Drive innovation with entrepreneurial thinking in fintech ecosystems
Lead financial decision-making in dynamic and technology-driven environments

semesters.title: Semester 1
semesters.text: Semester 1 builds strong foundations in communication, AI tools, and global business, while preparing students with essential leadership, planning, and career skills.

courses.title: Professional Communication and Presentation Skills
courses.text: Develops clear, confident and persuasive communication skills for leadership, collaboration and professional success.

title.strong: Modern Age AI Tools (Generative AI Tools)

courses.text: Master generative AI tools to analyse data, visualise insights, forecast trends, model decisions and automate solutions for complex business challenges.
Provides key insights into global markets and trends, enabling informed strategic decisions in a dynamic economy.

title.strong: Career and Leadership Development I:Career Planning & Goal Setting

courses.text: Develop skills to define career goals, create actionable plans and make informed decisions for professional growth and long-term success.
Explore digital banking and neobanking models, understanding innovative financial technologies, customer-centric services and emerging trends shaping the future of banking.

compare.title: Why our Semester 1 curriculum outpaces every other business school
compare.text: Early foundation in finance, global business, AI tools, leadership, and electives, blending theory with practical applications for future-ready financial expertise.
